info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondence Retrieval API
info.description: The Correspondence Retrieval API enables users to access and retrieve various banking correspondence documents. These documents may include important financial statements, account notifications, and regulatory communications essential for customer review and compliance purposes. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and developers building customer service applications that require document access. With this API, applications can efficiently fetch necessary documentation to enhance customer interactions and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of correspondence documents stored in the system. You can filter, sort, and paginate the results based on various criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve correspondence documents. It should contain the necessary parameters that define the criteria for filtering and fetching the desired documents.

200.description: The request was successful, and the corresponding documents are returned.

GetCorrespondenceDocumentsRequest.description: A JSON-formatted string representing the request body for retrieving correspondence documents.

GetCorrespondenceDocumentsResponse_200.title: Documents Correspondence Response

items.description: Array of document objects returned in the response.

sort.description: Sorting information for the items listed.

metadata.description: Metadata information associated with the response.

GetCorrespondenceDocumentsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on documents correspondence endpoint, containing a list of document items along with pagination, sorting, and metadata information.
